subject: Admin activity export: SIG evidence request & sampling options
messages:
From: Jamie Smith <jamie.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: admin activity evidence details and sampling question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our SIG team needs a concise description of what Redwood logs for admin activity (who did what, when, and where), the retention defaults, and what export options you can provide for evidence delivery. Two specific asks:  

1) For SOC-equivalent evidence, can you provide a daily snapshot that includes: timestamp (UTC), actor id, action type, target resource id, request metadata (IP/region), and a reference to any KV cache or model-variant used?
2) For the export we may need a redacted sample set (PII removed) for the external auditor and an unredacted bundle for on-prem handoff. Can you outline your redaction controls and supported formats (CSV, gzipped JSONL, signed manifests)?

Can you also confirm typical export delivery times for 7, 30, and 90 day lookbacks and whether you support sampling (e.g., 1% slice or per-user timebox)?

We need this by EOD Oct 6 to keep the audit timeline.

—Jamie
Jamie Smith
Senior Compliance Manager, Acme Health
compliance@acmehealth.com

(Attachment referenced: external-evidence-template.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Smith <jamie.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: admin activity evidence details and sampling question

Hi Jamie —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Short answer: yes, we can provide both redacted samples and unredacted export bundles; we offer multiple export formats and flexible sampling. Below is a high-level summary; I'll follow up with internal ops to confirm delivery SLAs and include an export-options matrix.

What we log (admin activity summary)
• Timestamp (UTC) + ISO offset
• Actor (internal user id / service account)
• Action type (api:Generate, ui:ModelRollback, key:Create, role:Grant, etc.)
• Target resource (project id, model id, route id)
• Request metadata (source IP, geo-region, user agent)
• Response trace id and token usage
• Model execution metadata (model variant tag, quantization profile) when applicable
• Audit-level context: can include request headers, forwarded_for, and auth method

Retention and export options
• Hosted default retention: 90 days of fine-grained admin events, 1 year aggregated indices.
• Dedicated/Private: configurable retention; commonly 1 year fine-grained on Dedicated with longer cold archives on request.
• Export formats supported: gzipped JSONL (line-delimited events), CSV manifest slices, and signed TAR.GZ bundles with a SHA256 manifest file.

Redaction and sampling controls
• PII redaction: built-in field-level scrubbers (email, IP partial, device ids) + customer-configurable redaction rules.
• Sampling: time-window slices (per-user or per-resource) and rate sampling (fixed percentage with reproducible seed).
• Proof of completeness: signed manifests with event counts and HMAC for each slice.

Next steps: I'll loop in Kim (operations) and Karthik (security) to clarify turnaround times for 7/30/90 day exports and to attach a sample manifest CSV and export-options matrix.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: admin-activity-sample-manifest.csv)

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: FW: SIG: admin activity evidence details and sampling question

Marissa / Karthik — quick ops/security notes to include in the reply to Acme.

Operational SLAs (typical)
• 7-day window: ad-hoc export delivered within 24 hours for hosted customers, 8 hours for Dedicated with reserved capacity.
• 30-day window: delivered within 48 hours (hosted), 24 hours (Dedicated).
• 90-day window: delivered within 72 hours for hosted (we may run on-demand snapshot job), 48 hours Dedicated.

Large-scale exports and handoffs
• For unredacted handoff (on-prem or SFTP), we provide a signed TAR.GZ with a manifest and SHA256 checksums. Delivery is via customer-specified SFTP, presigned cloud storage link, or physical encrypted drive for very large datasets.
• If customer requests, we can provide an attestable sampling manifest (e.g., deterministic 1% sample seeded by timestamp) and include the sampling seed in the manifest so auditors can re-generate slices.

Security notes
• HMAC-signed manifests for integrity; optional notarization for chain-of-custody.
• KMS-wrapped keys for bundles in transit and at rest; HSM options for Private deployments.
• Redaction rules are executed server-side before providing auditor-facing samples; we can allow an auditor NDA-driven, timebox-limited view into unredacted slices under supervision for critical reviews.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

(On a technical note: for the export-options matrix I attached a short PDF that maps format vs. redaction vs. delivery. Recommend sharing that.)

Subject: Re: SIG: admin activity evidence details and sampling question

Jamie —

Thanks for the patience. Per our internal review here are the agreed items and next steps so you can present to your SIG reviewer:  

Summary of deliverables
1) Redacted sample bundle (auditor-facing): gzipped JSONL with field-level PII scrubbed, plus admin-activity-sample-manifest.csv that lists event counts and sampling seed. Delivery: within 48 hours.
2) Unredacted export (evidence handoff): signed TAR.GZ with SHA256 manifest. Delivery: within 72 hours for 30/90 day ranges; expedited 24 hour for 7-day on Dedicated. Transfer: SFTP or pre-signed cloud URL per your preference.
3) Sampling options: deterministic percent sampling (seeded) or per-user timebox slices. Manifest includes seed and checksum so auditors can verify slice reproducibility.
4) Retention defaults: hosted default 90 days fine-grained, aggregated indices 1 year; Dedicated/Private can be extended — please indicate desired retention if longer.

Operational and security guarantees
• All bundles include an HMAC-signed manifest and SHA256 checksums.
• KMS-backed encryption in transit and at rest; HSM available for Private deployments.
• Redaction rules applied server-side; if you need supervised auditor access to unredacted slices we'll prepare an NDA and timeboxed session.

Attachments included:
• admin-activity-sample-manifest.csv — sample event manifest and field mapping
• export-options-matrix.pdf — matrix of formats, redaction levels, delivery methods, and SLA windows

Please confirm: preferred delivery method (SFTP vs. presigned link) and which lookback windows you want in the unredacted bundle (7 / 30 / 90 days). Once you confirm we'll create a HubSpot record and schedule the export job.

Best regards,
Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
